beta.notes: New: People & Nearby (AirDrop-style, accept once), send to many people, share links (expiry, password, download limit), drop rooms, Shelf (clipboard & screenshots on all your devices, Mac menu bar), event mode, QR pairing, NFC tap (phones), Quick Settings tiles, avatars, photo/text preview, stats, Undo send, browse & pull files from your devices, safety warning for apps, notification centre, much faster direct transfers, and direct transfers from the web app. Every button now has a springy press, glow and haptic.
